So off I went with the directions listed in Google.  When o arrived i quickly realized this was not what I had booked. But when Nancy came out to greet me and the dogs, she was so welcoming and the boys seemed quite comfortable that I made the decision right there that they were going to stay at Small Paws until I returned home on Sunday.
